messages:
Eve: Heads-up  EnterpriseBank POC next week. They want: streaming SDK demo (websocket style), function/tool call example to fetch internal CRM fields, structured JSON output validation, short security answers, and a pricing sketch comparing hosted streaming vs Dedicated 2G commit. Who can pick this up?

Marco: I can own the SDK bits. Clarify: websocket streaming + function_call auto, plus a REST fallback for legacy infra?

Eve: Yes websocket streaming preferred; include REST fallback. They also want a JSON schema so downstream ETL can ingest.

Tess: I'll draft the security FAQ. Key asks: are raw prompts stored, can they use their KMS, retention windows, VPC options, subprocessors. Send me the exact Qs and I'll produce short canned answers.

Marco: Sample Node snippet (trimmed):
```js
// websocket streaming + function call
const c = new RedwoodWS(url, apiKey);
c.on('token', t=>process.stdout.write(t));
c.on('function_call', async fc=>{ /* call internal CRM and return result */ });
c.send({model:'redwood-1-stream',stream:true,function_call:'auto',schema:{type:'object',properties:{intent:{type:'string'},customer:{type:'object'}},required:['intent']}});
```
Include fallback: if function fails, emit short text and a structured error object.

Rishi: I'll do pricing table. Quick notes: hosted streaming price per 1M tokens for discussion; Dedicated 2G commit monthly rate with approximate sustained tokens/sec and % cost reduction at 10M+/month. I'll add 3-month vs 12-month commit examples.

Eve: infra-bot will spin up a demo env.

deploy-bot: Demo env created: id=entbank-1782001122, url=https://console.redwood.example/poc/entbank-1782001122

Marco: For structured validation show AJV example and a tiny repair helper for partial JSON from streams. Also include small test harness command: `docker run --rm redwood/poc-harness --scenario=streaming-crm`

Tess: Drafted answers: prompts are not stored by default for hosted; we offer customer-managed KMS in Private; retention configurable up to 36 months; VPC/offline options available for Private; subprocessors list in legal portal and I'll attach. Flagging legal on KMS SLA.

Rishi: Also include a throughput demo plan: 5 concurrent editors for 2 minutes, measure avg latency and tokens/sec. That will help justify Dedicated sizing.

Eve: Action items: Marco -> repo with websocket + REST examples + README; Tess -> short security FAQ + subprocessors link; Rishi -> pricing one-pager with math. Review tomorrow 9:30am PT.

Marco: On it, will include explicit function-call auth pattern (service account token) and sample error-handling for missing CRM fields.

Tess: Looping in legal after I finish answers.

Eve: Thanks team :thumbsup: Let's keep responses concise for the customer-facing one-pager.
